title: Every draft, saved
logline: A worker deep in a draft knocks coffee onto the laptop, and the dead screen comes back with every word still there.
stake: an afternoon's draft on a laptop, a full mug at the elbow

turn.what: the dead screen wakes with the draft restored, cursor where it stopped

payoff: the soaked laptop shows the whole draft; the worker cheers
sound_off: He spilled coffee on his laptop, thought the draft was gone, and it came back saved.
send_line: send this to the friend who keeps coffee next to their laptop

hooks.frame0: the worker types at speed; the mug edges toward the laptop with every keystroke
the restored draft glows on a coffee-soaked laptop, the worker mid-cheer, then a flash rewind
extreme close-up: one coffee drop falling toward a key in slow motion

shots.action: the worker types at speed on a white desk; the full mug edges toward the laptop with each keystroke
shots.sound: typing burst on frame 0; a pleased wordless hum

shots.action: a big satisfied stretch; one arm sweeps out past the mug
the hand clips the mug; coffee floods under the laptop; the screen dies; the worker freezes
shots.sound: ceramic clink; splash; pour; a tape-stop as the screen dies; a gasp
shots.camera: locked, 35 mm, no move on the impact

shots.action: the worker's face; shoulders drop; only the eyes move

transition.reason: EMOTION: the loss lands on the face

shots.action: the dead screen wakes by itself; the draft is back, the cursor blinking where it stopped
shots.sound: a bright win sting on the wake

shots.action: a slow wow, then a two-armed cheer
shots.sound: a wordless wow; a tada on the cheer

shots.action: the white world pulls back; end line, logo and fine print
shots.camera: pull back, locked at the end
